name: Dorothy
source:
The second robot activated by Ryuunosuke after Alice refused to follow his orders. 
Loyal and capable, she is the perfect maid that Ryuunosuke wanted. 

[spoiler]She later adopts a strange mutated creature from the wastelands as a pet.[/spoiler]
